modelClaim.name: Kling 4.0
modelClaim.sourceTextOriginal: Hello there, everyone! Hope you’re having a great day 😉 Sorry for not being active lately. I’ve been busy with work, and I also think I caught a cold, but now I’m feeling much better. Just one more night shift, and after that, I hope I’ll have 4 days off 😁 Here is another Kling 4.0 video. You can find the prompt below 😊

originalPrompt: Three explorers walk through tall grass on an alien plain as a herd of enormous six-legged creatures passes nearby. The animals lower their long necks to feed while smaller creatures fly around them. One explorer raises a scanner and another follows the herd. Cinematic tracking shot, realistic creature animation, sense of wonder.
